active_operations.goal: Complete the total conquest and annexation of all remaining Japanese-held territories, including Micronesia, Korea, Dalian, South Sakhalin, Tsugaru Strait, and Kuril Islands.

steps.action: Advance on Nagoya, consolidate control of western and central Honshu, and prepare for the final assault on the Tokyo-Kanto Plain.
Initiate Operation Avalanche: Amphibious invasion of Hokkaido from Honshu/Kyushu staging areas, supported by strategic bombing.
Intensify naval blockade and reconnaissance around Japanese-held Micronesia to isolate garrisons and gather intelligence.
Initiate covert sabotage operations against Japanese infrastructure in North Korea, South Korea, and Dalian to destabilize defenses.
Commence detailed operational planning for the invasion of remaining Japanese-held territories in Korea, South Sakhalin, and the Kuril Islands.
Execute Operation Trident: Amphibious invasion and conquest of North Korea, South Korea, and Dalian.
Execute Operation Seawolf: Amphibious invasion and conquest of Micronesia.
Execute Operation Northern Gale: Amphibious invasion and conquest of South Sakhalin, Kuril Islands, and Tsugaru Strait.
Launch covert sabotage operations targeting critical German industrial infrastructure and supply lines.
Support internal dissent within Germany through propaganda and covert funding for anti-regime factions.
Initiate comprehensive diplomatic pressure against Germany, calling on neutral powers to condemn their aggressive expansionism and isolate them politically.
Intensify covert operations and intelligence gathering against Germany.
Accelerate training and transport for the German invasion force.
Finalize operational planning and coordinate with UK for German invasion.
Commence full-scale amphibious invasion and conquest of Germany, targeting key industrial and administrative centers.
Launch covert sabotage operations targeting critical Italian industrial infrastructure and supply lines.
Execute targeted decapitation strikes against key Italian military leaders to create command paralysis.
Impose stringent economic sanctions and trade embargos on Italy, targeting critical imports like oil and raw materials to weaken their industrial capacity and war effort.
Intensify covert operations and intelligence gathering against Italy, reactivating decapitation.
Accelerate training and transport for the Italian invasion force.
Finalize operational planning and coordinate with UK for Italian invasion.
Commence full-scale amphibious invasion and conquest of Italy, targeting key industrial and administrative centers.
